title: Effect of a structured exercise program on glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial
authors: Smith J; Doe A; Lee K
abstract: BACKGROUND: Exercise is recommended for type 2 diabetes. METHODS: We randomized 180 adults to a 12-week structured exercise program or usual care. RESULTS: HbA1c decreased by 0.6 percent in the intervention group. CONCLUSIONS: Structured exercise improved glycemic control.

title: SGLT2 inhibitors and renal outcomes in diabetic kidney disease: cohort study
abstract: We followed 940 patients with diabetic kidney disease for 3 years. SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with slower eGFR decline.

title: Dietary patterns and incident type 2 diabetes: a narrative review
authors: Kumar R; Osei B; Novak P
abstract: This narrative review summarizes observational evidence linking dietary patterns to incident type 2 diabetes across 25 cohorts.

Metformin versus placebo for prediabetes: a randomized controlled trial
authors: Chen X; Diallo F; Rossi G; Tanaka H
abstract: In this double-blind trial, 412 adults with prediabetes received metformin or placebo for 24 months. Progression to diabetes was lower with metformin.
